purpose: Choose one frozen scoring method for each split before inspecting component ablation results

methods.B0p: Count each drug's positive associations in the training fold; no expression feature use.
methods.B1k: Propagate training-fold positive associations from expression-similar drugs (10 neighbors).
methods.B1: Rank drugs by negative Spearman correlation between drug and disease expression signatures; no association labels used.
methods.B2: Fixed equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion of B0p, B1k and B1 (k=60).

splits.random_simple: Hold out 20% of drug-disease pairs at random; training can include associations for the same drugs.
splits.weakly_correlated: Hold out drugs selected to have weak expression similarity to training drugs; for fixed features this runner repeats one outer holdout across seeds.
